描述_EN: this example, dated between 1100 and 1000 bc, has a three character inscription under the handle: 'ju fu yi'; the last two graphs can be translated as 'father yi'. bronze vessels were considered an important symbol of status and authority during the same period and were buried in the graves of their owners. it was probably a dedicatory inscription connected with the execution of rites. this vessel, known in china as jue, was mainly used during the shang (1700-1050 bc) and western zhou (1050-771 bc) dynasties during the ritual celebrations of the ancestors.
描述_ZN: this example, dated between 1100 and 1000 bc, has a three character inscription under the handle: 'ju fu yi'; the last two graphs can be translated as 'father yi'. 青铜器在同一时期被认为是地位和权威的重要象征，并被埋葬在其主人的坟墓中。 这可能是一个与执行仪式有关的奉献性铭文。 这种器皿在中国被称为 "爵"，主要在商代（公元前1700-1050年）和西周（公元前1050-771年）时期用于祭祀祖先的仪式。
